# 💡 Holonic BRAID
**concept** · shared · knowledge

Bounded reasoning graphs stored as holons. BRAID symbolic reasoning (Mermaid flowcharts) shared across agents. Learn once, reuse everywhere. The corpus's own synthesis, made on 2026-02-26 when the BRAID and OASIS holonic analyses were written together; dated on purpose, so it is read as a synthesis and not a coincidence.
